# ledring.dev

> Open-source projects by Felix Fang: maps, mind maps, research, agent traces and workflows, most with a side door for agents.

## Projects

- [maptaste](https://maptaste.ledring.dev) ([source](https://github.com/FelixFangX/maptaste)): MapLibre style taste for coding agents: check, load a pack, and turn rainbow buildings into cinematic sequential blues. Source: [GitHub](https://github.com/FelixFangX/maptaste). MCP: maptaste-mcp
- [lakeboard-converter](https://convert.ledring.dev): Turns Yuque Lakeboard and XMind mind maps into Markdown, so the ideas stop being trapped in a picture. Source: [GitHub](https://github.com/FelixFangX/lakeboard-converter). MCP: npx -y lakeboard-converter mcp
- [dashtaste](https://github.com/FelixFangX/dashtaste): Dashboard taste as a skill + check loop: shape ECharts charts, check the result, and revise. Source: [GitHub](https://github.com/FelixFangX/dashtaste)
- [Research](https://research.ledring.dev): For when you have a vague research itch. You get ranked directions backed by real papers, plus a 7-day plan. Source: [GitHub](https://github.com/FelixFangX/research-thinking-ai)
- [LEDRING / LEDRING Play](https://play.ledring.dev/play/): Status lights for agents, plus a browser game where an AI builds a web page and you decide what ships. Source: [GitHub](https://github.com/FelixFangX/ledring)
- [dev-work-grok-bot-skill](https://github.com/FelixFangX/dev-work-grok-bot-skill): An Agent skill that turns a chat bot into a careful dev assistant. It drafts first and asks before anything leaves the room. Source: [GitHub](https://github.com/FelixFangX/dev-work-grok-bot-skill)
- [n8n-workflow-collection](https://github.com/FelixFangX/n8n-workflow-collection): Import-ready n8n workflows, secrets scrubbed: Lark/Feishu bot → Bitable records and PRD drafts, and social metrics. Source: [GitHub](https://github.com/FelixFangX/n8n-workflow-collection)
- [FelixFangX · control room](https://github.com/FelixFangX/FelixFangX): My GitHub profile, rebuilt every day from real runs and evals. Source: [GitHub](https://github.com/FelixFangX/FelixFangX)
